people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram who oppressed Israel

people.name: Hazael
people.line: King of Aram (Syria), anointed by Elijah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria

translations.web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.
translations.bsb: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them continually into the hands of Hazael king of Aram and his son Ben-hadad.
translations.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
translations.asv: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.
